headlines.title: Classified NSA network is still down, leaving some staff working from home
headlines.description: The network went down on Tuesday due to a technical problem during maintenance operations, but sources say it has not affected its work collecting electronic intelligence.

headlines.title: Anthropic is about to be worth more than $1 trillion. What that means for the rest of us.
headlines.description: Leading AI lab Anthropic is expected to make the largest-ever public market debut when it starts trading on the Nasdaq stock exchange Thursday.

headlines.title: National security and AI figures urge DOJ to probe what Nvidia knew about chip smuggling
headlines.description: A letter from 15 national security and AI leaders scrutinized the chipmaker’s knowledge of illegal transfers of its chips to China.

headlines.title: Amid string of outages, bipartisan letter urges strategy to combat AI-assisted cyber threats
headlines.description: In the midst of a series of recent cyber outages, there is growing concern by members of Congress that the Trump administration needs to do more to protect infrastructure from cyberattacks that are aided by AI, according to a new bipartisan letter sent by two senators to the White House’s AI czar.

headlines.title: 'It's an extraordinary morning': College student reacts to Anthropic and GTA's big day
headlines.description: A college student speaks with Christine Romans on his experience buying Anthropic shares and playing the new Grand Theft Auto on the same day both were released.

headlines.title: National security and AI leaders urge Justice Department to investigate Nvidia
headlines.description: A group of national security experts and AI policy leaders are urging the Justice Department to investigate Nvidia's alleged involvement in smuggling chips to China. NBC News' AI reporter Jared Perlo talks about what the letter entails and why the investigation is crucial in the AI race between the U.S. and China.

headlines.title: New Space Simulator Allows Researchers to Visit Moon and Mars
headlines.description: Texas A&M University is giving students and scientists the chance to experience what it’s like to walk on the moon and mars with its new space simulator and it could be a game changer for the future of space exploration. NBC’s Ryan Chandler shares a first look for TODAY.

headlines.title: Anthropic to Price Stock at $83 a Share, Valuing it Above $1 Trillion
headlines.description: Anthropic, known for its Claude AI chatbot, is going public Thursday morning and will appear on the NASDAQ as ANT. The company is pricing its shares at $83 apiece, which could skyrocket Anthropic’s value to a jaw-dropping $1.5 trillion. NBC’s Christine Romans joins TODAY to discuss all the hype surrounding the potential record-breaking IPO debut.

headlines.title: Trump pushes back on global regulation of AI while speaking at APEC
headlines.description: President Trump spoke about AI during the APEC summit, reiterating his proposed rebranding of it as SI, “super intelligence.” He warned that while there is a need to be careful of some of AI's "bad elements", he also expressed opposition to any global regulations.

headlines.title: Elon Musk says he feels 'foolish' after spending hundreds of millions backing Republicans
headlines.description: Elon Musk told the New York Times in a video interview at the Dealbook Summit that he feels "foolish" after spending nearly half a billion dollars backing Republicans in the midterm elections. As a new crop of Democrats prepare to enter Congress, some are talking about opening investigations into the Tesla CEO over his involvement in DOGE.

headlines.title: Inside world’s largest electronic market in China
headlines.description: Tens of thousands of vendors sell tech and electronics inside Huaqiangbei. Shoppers can check out drones, tablets, toys, and gaming systems. NBC News’ Tom Llamas got an inside look.

headlines.title: Inside China’s AI-powered Silicon Valley
headlines.description: NBC Nightly News anchor Tom Llamas reports from China’s version of Silicon Valley in Shenzhen, where a fierce race for AI dominance is transforming the city with self-driving taxis, delivery drones and humanoid robots.
